description:
The process begins when a customer files a complaint about a product or service.
Customer service logs the complaint and assigns it to the relevant department for investigation.
After reviewing the details, the team determines whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified and notifies the customer with the decision.
If a refund is approved, the financial team processes the reimbursement.
The complaint is marked as resolved once the customer receives the refund or directly after notifying the customer in case the refund was rejected.
After resolving the case, customers can provide feedback on their satisfaction.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Complaint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint-process">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Complaint Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ComplaintFiled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FeedbackProvided</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer Service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Resolve_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Relevant Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineValidity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Financial Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessReimbursement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewComplaint" name="Review complaint details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineValidity" name="Determine complaint validity and refund justification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer of decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Resolve_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide satisfaction feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackProvided" name="Feedback provided"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LogComplaint" sourceRef="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignComplaint" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewComplaint" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineValidity" sourceRef="Task_ReviewComplaint" targetRef="Task_DetermineValidity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyCustomer" sourceRef="Task_DetermineValidity" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRefundDecision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_Resolve_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReimbursementDone" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Gateway_Resolve_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMarkResolved" sourceRef="Gateway_Resolve_Merge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToFeedback" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackProvided"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
